title: MeshPilot
shortDescription: Independent client for your own MeshCentral server: desktop, terminal, files
fullDescription:
MeshPilot is an independent Android client for your own MeshCentral server. Use it to reach computers you are authorized to manage from a phone or tablet.

You need a MeshCentral server reachable over HTTPS and an account on that server. No server or account is preconfigured. MeshPilot does not install, host, or administer MeshCentral, and it is not a MeshCentral agent.

Features:
• Device list with search, favorites, and recent devices.
• Remote desktop with touch, trackpad, keyboard, clipboard text, and monitor switching.
• Terminal, file manager, SSH, and SFTP through server relays.
• Up to 20 server profiles with separate sign-in details.
• Optional app lock with a PIN or Android biometrics on supported devices.
• Free and open source, with no ads or analytics. You choose which MeshCentral server to use.

Remote control depends on your server configuration, your account rights, and the capabilities of the managed device. Some tools may be unavailable or view-only when the server or device does not permit them. Terminal commands, file operations, and power actions affect the remote computer; use them only on systems you are authorized to manage.

MeshPilot is a third-party project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by the MeshCentral project. Report problems with this app through the project's GitHub issue tracker, not to the MeshCentral team.
